title: lapis v1
hover_text: click to the first iteration of 'lapis'
meta_description: The first iteration of the lapis bluetooth speaker. Features Bluetooth 5.4, USB-C PD, stereo pairing, and a 6-hour battery life.

sections.heading: features
items: One large Speaker Driver (I had to dremel the aux port on every board to even make it fit lol)
400mah - 6 hour battery life at moderate volume (calculated)
Stereo pairing capability when you buy 2. They will connect and play bluetooth in stereo :3

sections.heading: the not-so-great stuff
sections.content: I iterated this to be the best quality speaker, while being easy to make and financially viable......... but nothing is perfect

items: something with the master/slave stereo mode makes them get corrupted when more are on at one time
no response from the board seller of these (DAU / BenLi Audio) about their firmware issues
I found who makes the bluetooth chips but no firmware to be found

sections.heading: what's next
sections.content: might have to figure out how to flash my own firmware or just make another big revision with a different board altogether. The goal is still making these sound awesome while being easy to build!
